=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > $ Device 'bind' Cloud | (Key) .
[B5] < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > < Cloud | 'owner' : nils , UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ Device 'bind' Cloud | (Key)
